history.value: When end-of-turn damage (Combust) breaks The Guardian's Mode Shift, the game queues its 20 Defensive block behind the monsters' turn start, so it keeps the block into the player's next turn; the engine adds it at once and monsters_turn clears it (live run 2026-11-14, run 8). Fix: defer it via deferred_block while the turn ends, land it after the block reset. Not done.

When end-of-turn damage (Combust) breaks The Guardian's Mode Shift, the game queues its 20 Defensive block behind the monsters' turn start (ChangeStateAction queues GainBlockAction after MonsterStartTurnAction), so it keeps the block into the player's next turn (live run 8). Fixed in 626955c6: monster block queued behind what is queued now waits in deferred_block during a card, potion or the turn end (turn_ending flag, Stage::EndingTurn) and monsters_turn lands it after the block reset; test act1_bosses guardian_shift_at_turn_end_keeps_its_block; golden unchanged.
